nodes.description: Public uint256 cap on the number of mintable Fuxi NFTs (8888).
Private mapping tokenId => number used as entropy source for traits.
Private array of five-element trait strings used for pseudo-random plucking.
Private array of gossip (bagua) trait strings used for pseudo-random plucking.
Private array of ten heavenly stems trait strings used for pseudo-random plucking.
Private array of earthly branch trait strings used for pseudo-random plucking.
Guard state (1 NOT_ENTERED / 2 ENTERED) read and written by the nonReentrant modifier.
Private owner address used by the onlyOwner access-control modifier.
internal pure; hashes an input string with keccak256 to derive pseudo-randomness.
public view; returns a five-element trait via pluck(tokenId, FIVEELEMENTS, fiveElements).
public view; returns a gossip trait via pluck(tokenId, GOSSIP, gossip).
public view; returns a heavenly stem trait via pluck(tokenId, TENDRY, tenDry).
public view; returns an earthly branch trait via pluck(tokenId, EARTHLYBRANCH, earthlyBranch).
internal view; reads numbers[tokenId], derives a hash-based index and indexes the source array.
public view; computes pseudo-random greatness from numbers[tokenId] and returns a Color struct.
public view override; assembles the SVG/JSON metadata string for a token using trait getters.
public nonReentrant mint entry point; derives tokenId, stores block.timestamp and safe-mints to the caller.
internal pure; converts a uint256 to its decimal string representation.
Deploys ERC721('Fuxi','FUXI') and Ownable(), which records the deployer as owner.
internal; mints a token and then invokes the ERC721 receiver check (external callback).
internal; validates, updates balances/owners and emits Transfer.
private; performs an external call to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on contract recipients.
internal hook invoked by mint/transfer/burn to maintain enumeration arrays.
public onlyOwner; changes the contract owner (access-control sensitive).
internal view; returns msg.sender, used for ownership and mint recipient resolution.
Attacker-controlled caller address, used as mint recipient and operator.
Miner-influenceable timestamp stored as token entropy inside claim().
External call to recipient's onERC721Received during safe mint, enabling callback reentrancy.
numbers[tokenId] = block.timestamp: timestamp-dependent state write influencing token traits.
tokenId = totalSupply() + 1: unbounded arithmetic used for the mint cap check.
_balances[to] += 1: balance arithmetic performed in _mint.
uint256 tokenId parameter of the trait getters and pluck.
string memory keyPrefix salt parameter of pluck.
string[] memory sourceArray trait list parameter of pluck.
string memory input parameter hashed by random().
address to recipient parameter of _mint/_safeMint.
bytes memory data parameter forwarded to onERC721Received.
uint256 number = numbers[tokenId] local inside pluck.
uint256 rand hash local inside getBackGround.
uint256 tokenId = totalSupply() + 1 local inside claim.
Color memory info struct local built in getBackGround.

edges.reason: block.timestamp is written into numbers[tokenId], making token traits miner-influenceable.
claim() performs the timestamp-dependent state write numbers[tokenId] = block.timestamp.
claim() computes tokenId as totalSupply() + 1 before the maxLimit check.
claim() calls _safeMint, which performs an external callback while state is already written.
_safeMint delegates to _checkOnERC721Received to invoke the recipient contract.
_checkOnERC721Received externally calls IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on an attacker-controlled contract.
msg.sender is passed as the mint recipient in claim() with no authorisation check.
msg.sender is forwarded as the operator argument of the external onERC721Received callback.
_mint increments _balances[to] by 1.
_safeMint first calls _mint to create the token.
The nonReentrant modifier on claim() reads and writes the _status guard state.
pluck reads the token entropy from the numbers mapping.
getBackGround reads numbers[tokenId] to derive trait randomness.
pluck uses random() to hash the salt and derive the array index.
getFiveElements calls pluck with the fiveElements array.
getGossip calls pluck with the gossip array.
getTenDry calls pluck with the tenDry array.
geTearthlyBranch calls pluck with the earthlyBranch array.
getBackGround derives its hash through random().
tokenURI calls getBackGround to obtain the Color struct.
tokenURI calls toString to render the token id into the metadata.
tokenURI calls getFiveElements when assembling the SVG parts.
tokenURI calls getGossip when assembling the SVG parts.
tokenURI calls getTenDry when assembling the SVG parts.
tokenURI calls geTearthlyBranch when assembling the SVG parts.
claim compares the derived tokenId against maxLimit before minting.
_msgSender() returns the msg.sender untrusted input.
The constructor resolves the deployer through _msgSender().
transferOwnership resolves the caller through _msgSender() for the onlyOwner check.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable after the onlyOwner authorisation check.
The tokenId parameter determines which entropy entry pluck reads.
The keyPrefix parameter is hashed by pluck to salt the randomness.
The sourceArray parameter is indexed by the derived random value.
The input string is hashed inside random().
The to parameter becomes the new owner and the credited balance in _mint.
The data parameter is forwarded to the ERC721 receiver callback by _safeMint.
Local number caches numbers[tokenId] inside pluck.
Local rand caches the hash output driving the trait branch selection.
Local claimTokenId is produced by the totalSupply()+1 computation.
Local claimTokenId is the value validated, stored and minted by claim().
The info Color struct built by getBackGround flows into tokenURI's SVG assembly.
_mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer enumeration hook.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenId parameter only exists to select the entropy entry consumed inside pluck().
keyPrefix is a pure local salt argument used only by pluck().
sourceArray is the trait list indexed inside pluck().
input is the sole argument hashed by random() and has no independent state effect.
to is the recipient consumed directly by _mint when writing balances and owners.
data is only forwarded to the receiver callback by _safeMint.
number is a temporary cache of numbers[tokenId] inside pluck().
rand is a temporary hash value scoped to getBackGround().
claimTokenId is the transient mint id computed and used only inside claim().
info is the Color struct assembled and returned by getBackGround().
